claims.text: Most uncomp MRSA skin and soft tissue infections: empiric oral TMP-SMX, a tetracycline (doxycycline or minocycline) or clindamycin
claims.quote: For most uncomplicated SSTIs, empirical treatment is with oral antibiotics, eg, trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole, tetracyclines (eg, doxycycline or minocycline), or clindamycin.
